selection.extraRule: Every geonameid in place_clocks.tsv or place_zones.tsv

alternateNamesMeasurement.encoding: compact UTF-8 JSON arrays [string id,name,lang,preferred,short,colloquial,historic], LF; not shipped

calendar: Tower Julian dates through 1582-10-04 are refused: Zīj civil datetime is proleptic Gregorian, so those readings cannot be silently reinterpreted. Gregorian from 1582-10-15; astronomical years -500..2200.
zoneTransitions: All TZif transitions; pinned POSIX tails expanded through 2201 with Python zoneinfo rules, to cover the page ending in 2200.
searchTransport: Lossless one- or two-character folded-prefix shards; per-shard dictionaries preserve the same records. ASCII equal to name is null in transport. Name and ASCII prefix placements are both indexed.

place_clocks.tsv.reassembly: Concatenate part bytes in the listed order; no headers are added or removed.
